professionalSummary: Experienced iOS developer with a track record of shipping production features in Swift and SwiftUI, managing in-app subscriptions, triaging crashes, and ensuring accessibility compliance.
Proven ability to participate in bi‑weekly App Store releases and collaborate with cross‑functional teams.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the iOS Engineer, Subscription App role.

evidence.text: Built the sleep-timer and offline-download features in SwiftUI for the Tidewell audio app, from design review to release.
evidence.notes: Directly demonstrates production feature development in SwiftUI.

evidence.text: Work sample: a pull request for the offline-download queue in SwiftUI, with the async download manager, unit tests and screenshots at three Dynamic Type sizes, approved by two reviewers.
evidence.notes: Shows code quality and review process.

evidence.text: Took part in a team workshop on StoreKit 2 ahead of a planned paywall redesign; the subscription code itself was maintained by the other iOS engineer.
evidence.notes: Participation in workshop, not direct implementation.

missingEvidence: Evidence of direct implementation or maintenance of StoreKit 2 subscription code by the candidate.

evidence.text: Reviewed the Crashlytics report after each release and fixed the highest-volume crashes, including a Core Data threading crash on older devices.
Added VoiceOver labels and Dynamic Type support to the player and library screens, testing with the accessibility inspector.
Prepared release notes and ran the TestFlight checks for the fortnightly App Store releases.
evidence.notes: Shows participation in bi‑weekly release process.
